annotations.title: Function Overview
annotations.content: This function handles the complete workflow of publishing a CSV file as a hosted feature layer. It manages the asynchronous publishing process and monitors job status.

annotations.title: CSV Requirements
annotations.content: The CSV file must contain latitude/longitude columns or address fields for geocoding. Ensure your CSV has proper coordinate data before publishing.

annotations.title: Asynchronous Publishing
annotations.content: Using future=True enables asynchronous publishing, allowing the script to monitor progress. The future.result() call blocks until completion.

annotations.title: Monitoring Loop
annotations.content: The monitoring loop checks every 5 seconds for up to 5 minutes. This prevents the script from hanging on failed publishing jobs.

annotations.title: Success Handling
annotations.content: When publishing completes successfully, the function returns the new feature layer item with its unique ID and metadata.

annotations.title: Connection Setup
annotations.content: Replace the connection parameters with your actual ArcGIS Online or Enterprise portal URL and credentials. Consider using environment variables for security.

annotations.title: Item ID Required
annotations.content: You need to replace 'your_csv_item_id' with an actual CSV item ID from your ArcGIS content. Use gis.content.search() to find CSV items.

annotations.title: Publishing Workflow
annotations.content: The main workflow: 1) Connect to GIS, 2) Get CSV item, 3) Publish as feature layer, 4) Handle results. This pattern works for any CSV publishing scenario.
